issues.description: The `Deref` contract spells sequence-view equality as a length clause plus a triggered pointwise quantifier instead of one direct model equality.
issues.rationale: The two clauses manually encode equality element by element and introduce an explicit trigger. The collaborator requests a simpler model-level equality; the final commit replaces both clauses with `ret@.map_values(|region| region@) == self@.regions`, preserving the necessary element-view conversion while eliminating the quantifier. This is the local `quantifiers-and-triggers` preference for a direct standard expression when no indexing/trigger need justifies a manual quantifier.
